dashboard.name: SlotSaver: Executive Attendance & Revenue Recovery Analytics
dashboard.description: Comprehensive BI analytics tracking longitudinal no-show reduction, multi-channel reminder conversion rates, waitlist refill velocity, and recovered revenue.

cards.name: 26-Week No-Show Rate Longitudinal Trend
cards.description: Weekly no-show percentage demonstrating transition from baseline (22%) to full SlotSaver suite (<5%).

native.query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', b.start_at) AS week, COUNT(*) AS total_appointments, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.status = 'no_show' THEN 1 END) AS no_shows, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN b.status = 'no_show' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS no_show_rate_pct FROM bookings b JOIN businesses bus ON b.business_id = bus.id WHERE b.start_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '26 weeks' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', b.start_at) ORDER BY week ASC;

cards.name: Recovered Revenue by Service via Waitlist Cascade
cards.description: Direct revenue saved by automatically re-monetizing cancelled appointments through 15-minute waitlist holds.

native.query: SELECT s.name AS service_name, COUNT(w.id) AS refilled_slots_count, SUM(s.price) AS total_recovered_amount, ROUND(AVG(s.price), 2) AS avg_ticket_price FROM waitlist_entries w JOIN services s ON w.service_id = s.id WHERE w.status = 'claimed' GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY total_recovered_amount DESC;

cards.name: Multi-Channel Reminder Funnel & Handset Delivery
cards.description: Delivery receipts, confirmation ratios, and interactive button conversions across WhatsApp touchpoints.

native.query: SELECT r.delivery_status AS stage, COUNT(*) AS volume, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reminders), 1) AS pct_of_total FROM reminders r GROUP BY r.delivery_status ORDER BY volume DESC;

cards.name: Waitlist Refill Velocity (Minutes to Claim)
cards.description: Speed at which cancelled slots are accepted by waitlisted candidates during the 15-minute window.

native.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (w.updated_at - w.created_at)) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS avg_claim_minutes FROM waitlist_entries w WHERE w.status = 'claimed';

cards.name: Attendance Risk Tier & Deposit Compliance
cards.description: Distribution of appointments by predicted ML risk score tier and hold deposit status.

native.query: SELECT COALESCE(b.risk_tier, 'low') AS risk_tier, COUNT(*) AS booking_count, SUM(CASE WHEN b.deposit_status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deposits_collected, SUM(CASE WHEN b.deposit_status = 'forfeited' THEN b.deposit_amount ELSE 0 END) AS forfeited_amount FROM bookings b GROUP BY b.risk_tier ORDER BY booking_count DESC;
